verse.text: Let each generation tell its children of your mighty acts; let them proclaim your power.

video.title: Words and a Legacy to Live By | Amos 5:24 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Every dad is already writing a story his kids will retell for the rest of their lives — in the words he speaks, the way he prays, the patience he shows on hard days. You don't need a perfect testimony to pass on a real one; you just need to keep telling your kids what God has done, out loud, on purpose, today.
